verdict.rationale: The axis applies to Ollama as a model-serving API, but the evidence pack never documents native tool or function calling, or any reasoning/thinking parser. It mentions a REST API, a subset of the OpenAI API, and Anthropic Messages API compatibility for running coding agents like Claude Code. Agent compatibility only implies tool calling and is not explicit evidence of either capability, so the verdict stays at none.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use native tool-calling and reasoning-parser support in my requests
